For a standard ticket, what is my baggage allowance, including the checked-bag weight limit?

results.content: Standard tickets include one carry-on and one checked bag up to 50 pounds.

steps.message: For a standard ticket, you are allowed one carry-on and one checked bag. The checked bag has a weight limit of 50 pounds. If you have any other questions about baggage or your booking, feel free to ask!
